area: Classic campaign, fan and conversion completion
exitCriteria: Replay a winning route for every advertised Classic level, including the bundled fan corpus and conversions. Close the remaining Oh No! and Holiday routes. Verify continuous Full Quest progression, save/resume and final results. L2/L3 completion belongs to the sequel gate.
progress: 17 September: official Classic coverage is 281/292 (11 missing). Holiday 1993 and Holiday 1994 now have preserved wins for all 32 levels each. The remaining official gaps are 11 Oh No! routes. The 6,372-level audit from 15 September has 647 wins and zero load/start failures. There are 279 distinct hint decks and 282 distinct solution replays including conversions. The all-level requirement remains unchanged pending the owner’s scope decision. See OneZeroClosure-2026-09-15.md.

exitCriteria: Resolve provisional L3 tool, movement and trap semantics against original-engine evidence. Complete environmental effects, original movie audio and story transitions. Extend L2 original-engine comparisons. Record every L2/L3 winning route and verify continuous campaign progression, L2 survivor carry-over and endings.
progress: 15 September: Claude’s committed work preserves 73/120 L2 standalone routes and 41/90 L3 routes. Cavelems has a complete ten-level carry-over chain. L2 and L3 remain previews outside Classic 1.0 completion. Current known-route and runtime regression suites passed in the baseline audit.

exitCriteria: Verify app and controller interruption on real hardware. Add versioned in-progress checkpoints and crash recovery before mobile suspend/termination support. Verify save migrations and rollback with real prior releases.
progress: 15 September: all existing checkpoint, corruption, stale-writer and recovery tests pass. Ten new trials kill an isolated writer process during checkpoint updates, then validate the recovered checkpoint with a fresh reader. These pass. Classic wins now preserve validated input routes separately from recovery checkpoints. Physical interruption, installed prior-release migration and power-loss coverage remain distinct from these process tests. See OneZeroClosure-2026-09-15.md.

exitCriteria: Test the complete first-launch-to-results flow with physical Xbox, PlayStation and Switch-layout controllers. Add remapping and device glyphs, touch targeting, readable UI scaling, reduced motion/flash controls and VoiceOver navigation without forcing OG gameplay.
progress: Beta 25 passed complete software-driven journeys on Apple silicon and Intel/Rosetta. F retains the reached speed after release; mouse and keyboard speed arrows apply immediately from 1x. Green handover initials and the previous-level retry button were rendered and tested with real mouse events. Existing keyboard/controller routing, targeting, fonts, scalable menus, hints and interruption tests passed. Physical controllers and full VoiceOver remain unverified. See Beta25Readiness.md.

exitCriteria: Measure complete frame times, memory growth and audio under sustained 10x play, nukes, replays and repeated engine switches. Test physical Intel, minimum supported macOS, SDR/HDR, multiple displays and high refresh rates.
progress: 15 September: a repeated 20-scenario run exposed utility-priority replay encoder stalls under concurrent heavy work. User-initiated encoder priority completed all 20 scenarios with all 8,013 movie frames and no GPU errors. Queue size and the 500 ms input-blocking bound remain unchanged. Resident memory did not grow across five passes. Observed fast-forward was only 1.14–1.45× under contention, so sustained 10×, audible audio and the physical hardware matrix remain open. See PerformanceMeasurementClosure.md.

exitCriteria: Freeze the final source and assets. Build both Mac architectures, sign, notarise and verify the downloaded archive. Earlier beta notarisation is not evidence for later local builds.
progress: Beta 32 has notarised main and macOS 12 archives, plus a development-signed Game Center archive and standalone playable app for the registered Macs. The owner confirms live Game Center integration works. The current source contains later changes and needs its own source freeze, validation and package. See Documentation/Beta32Readiness.md.

exitCriteria: Agree the proposed official product scope, brand use and asset distribution with the rights holder. Record code and asset provenance, third-party dependencies and approved distribution inputs. Obtain the required platform publishing access.
progress: 15 September: Erik Veland explicitly confirmed approval to distribute the original assets in this task. The existing THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md records code and asset provenance. This records the owner’s approval, without extending it to unrequested platforms or claiming independent legal verification.

exitCriteria: Validate first-play onboarding with novice players. Extend verified tiered hints beyond the original 120 levels and show supported mechanics clearly in imported packs.
progress: 17 September: the owner reports regular personal and external tester play, no reported issues in Classic or early L2, and positive feedback. Verified tiered hints now extend beyond the original 120 to 281 official Classic levels, represented by 279 unique decks. The app hint journeys and catalogue checks pass. Tester feedback does not identify a separate first-time-player study.

exitCriteria: Build and test the shared library with the iOS SDK. Implement a UIKit/Metal app shell, precise touch selection, safe-area layouts, audio/session interruptions, checkpoints, thermal budgets and device tests. A Package.swift deployment declaration is not an iOS app.

Use approved SDKs and hardware to establish the supported runtime and engine boundary. Implement native rendering, input, save/user services and suspend/resume adapters. Pass each platform's current requirements. Mac controller support is not a console port.

Validate Game Center on provisioned builds, network loss and offline records. Externalise product strings and verify layouts with translated text. Define platform account and cloud-save conflict handling.
progress: 15 September: the owner confirms live Game Center integration works. Account-change regression tests now cover sign-out during a pending load, obsolete authentication callbacks, stale personal ranks and account-specific score submission. Local tests pass. Translation layout coverage and cloud-save conflict policy remain open.

exitCriteria: Deliver an approved, reproducible demonstration build with a short feature tour, current evidence matrix, known limits, asset provenance and a platform delivery plan. Keep demonstration claims within verified scope.
